task.description: Security review of tenant-data-path changes for AGT-01..04. Review the implementation in src/api/routes/agent_artifacts.zig and migrations/1171_agt01_03_agent_artifacts.sql against the numbered security invariants in docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. Pay special attention to: (1) tenant isolation — all queries must filter by tenant_id from the authenticated context, never from request body; (2) probe indistinguishability — AGT-02 403 response must not leak owner info for wrong-environment or any cross-tenant probe; (3) field authorisation — environment_class must come from deployment config only; (4) SQL parameterisation — all queries must use $N placeholders; (5) sandbox capability gating per invariants; (6) no catch unreachable on realistic failures. Return PASS if all invariants satisfied, FAIL with specific violation IDs if not.

result.summary: All 8 security invariants assessed against src/api/routes/agent_artifacts.zig, migrations/1171_agt01_03_agent_artifacts.sql, and src/main.zig diff. No BLOCKER violations found. Two minor findings documented below.

invariant_assessments.INV-1: PASS — staging.agent_artifacts is in the staging schema (not public, not tenant_<slug>). All SQL queries on it include WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid. The task_specs lookup is unqualified (resolves via search_path to the tenant schema — correct isolation). Unauthenticated requests default to DEFAULT_TENANT_ID (nil UUID), which has no task_specs, blocking artifact creation. Shared staging table pattern is architecturally intentional.
invariant_assessments.INV-2: PASS — Payload is never returned in responses. Response struct contains only artifact metadata (artifact_id, kind, task_spec_id, attempt_count, spec_hash, created_at, touched_at). Field selection is server-side before serialisation.
invariant_assessments.INV-3: N/A — No Lua/Wasm host functions added.
invariant_assessments.INV-4: PASS — Audit event ArtifactSubmissionRejected includes only principal (user_id) and environment_class literal 'production'. Artifact payload is never logged or included in the audit after_state or in any response.
invariant_assessments.INV-5: PASS — wrongEnv403() returns a fixed body with no environment-differentiating content. Cross-tenant task_spec probe returns same task_spec_not_found 404 as a genuinely non-existent spec (both paths: search_path-scoped task_specs lookup returns null). MINOR GAP: no integration test asserting response-byte-equality between cross-tenant probe and genuine not-found for this new resource type (per INV-5 verification guidance).
invariant_assessments.INV-6: PASS — This SECURITY-REVIEWER handoff satisfies the meta-invariant gate.
invariant_assessments.INV-7: PASS — All SQL queries use $N placeholders. No std.fmt.allocPrint in any SQL-construction path. Grep for allocPrint.*SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE returned zero hits.
invariant_assessments.INV-8: PASS — grep for 'catch unreachable' in agent_artifacts.zig returned zero hits.

issues.description: unknownKind400() echoes the user-supplied kind string using {s} format specifier without JSON escaping. A kind value containing '"', '\', or control characters produces a malformed JSON 400 response body. Not a server-security violation (no data exposure, no SQL path) but can cause JSON parse failures in monitoring/log-analysis tooling. Recommend routing received through appendJsonVal for consistent escaping.
issues.recommended_fix: In unknownKind400, serialise received via appendJsonVal into the buffer rather than using {s} directly.

issues.description: No integration test asserting response-byte-equality between cross-tenant task_spec probe and genuine not-found for agent_artifacts. Per INV-5 verification guidance, this gap should be closed by TEST-DESIGNER.
issues.recommended_fix: TEST-DESIGNER should add an integration test that submits a spec_hash belonging to tenant-B from tenant-A's context and asserts the 404 body is byte-identical to submitting a spec_hash that has never existed.
